name: Pantech Global Berhad
overview: 今年公司以约3173万令吉出售了一幅土地，同时进行了多项企业常规事项，包括更新股东授权、股份回购授权及派息。业务板块层面，公告中未披露产能扩张、新业务或新合约的具体信息。
overview_en: During the year, the company disposed of a parcel of land held by its wholly-owned subsidiary Pantech Steel Industries for approximately RM31.73 million; At the business segment level, the announcements did not disclose specific information on capacity expansion, new businesses or new contracts.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面主要公告为出售土地及常规企业事项，未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the main announcements this year were a land disposal and routine corporate matters; no specific operational changes for individual business segments were disclosed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Pantech Steel Industries Sdn. Bhd.与Veltrix Land Sdn. Bhd.签订买卖协议，以3173.1万令吉出售一幅永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Pantech Steel Industries Sdn. Bhd. entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Veltrix Land Sdn. Bhd. to dispose of a parcel of freehold land for RM31,731,000.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 以及更新最多占已发行股份总数10%的股份回购授权。
